svg.text: Writing 1.5 TiB of new data into the HC680 pool
Cumulative data written over time (fio, 1 MiB sequential, encrypted md RAID5 on 3 × dm-zoned). Steeper = faster.
~500 GiB: the plain members' drive buffers are full
Plain and 512 MiB runs were stopped once their steady phase was clear. One system: DS3622xs+ + DX1222 + 3 × HC680 27 TB, guest kernel 7.2.6.
